section_summary.extract_value: This section presents the title and authors of a paper describing a Dutch translation and validation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 conducted with female university students in the Netherlands. The text indicates a single investigation with a college sample and specifies use of the BAS-2; no sample size, age, BMI, racial composition, survey method, or correlations with BMI are reported here.
